name: self-host-cutover
title: Self-host cutover: drop Cloudflare Workers layer
description: Self-host is the only deployment target. Gate initOpenNextCloudflareForDev out of production server, verify pure DATABASE_URL path (isolation test), then delete the Workers layer: wrangler.jsonc, worker.ts, open-next config, cf:* scripts, @opennextjs/cloudflare imports. Move expireInvitations into the HTTP cron route, keep a Node-side auth rate limit, and update docs/spec.
